description: Derived from AGSC-03-10: an item with no inbound Link and no `clusters[]` entry MUST be reported as an orphan, the warning AGSC-E305. A `clusters[]` entry is an inbound reference to the cluster it names, so a cluster that one item lists is never an orphan (kept, listed by member). An inbound Link is any Link edge whose target is the item, authored or computed: linker authors `related` to linked and receives the computed symmetric edge, and user authors `uses` to used and receives the computed `used-by`, so none of those four is an orphan. An inline link is an `asc:mentions` edge and not a Link (AGSC-03-11), so mentioner, whose body links to target, gives target no inbound Link. The orphans are empty (a cluster no item lists), lonely, mentioner and target: four warnings, in slug order. Nothing is an error.

items.description: A cluster that one item lists, so it has an inbound reference.
A cluster that no item lists and no Link names.
